tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H=0.16–0.48, far shorter than the target horizon. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the competing long-term behaviors and helps identify the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both timescales or the long-horizon adaptation needed at H=22.5.
Additional fine short-window trajectories would be less directly informative about slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal or periodic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot alone does not distinguish these from the sink-coupled model at the target horizon.
